The Shape of SHACL

Released Oct 24, 2024, 7 min

Play The Shape of SHACL on YouTube
Watch on YouTube

The SHApes Constraint Language (SHACL) is the W3C standard for data validation. In this short video, Casey gives a basic overview of its functionality, and he points to the SHACL playground as a place to further hone your skills.
